items.title: Ukraine: EU belegt 113 Personen und Organisationen mit Sanktionen, um Russlands Fähigkeit zur Finanzierung seines Angriffskriegs weiter einzuschränken
items.teaser: Der Rat hat restriktive Maßnahmen gegen 12 Personen und 101 Organisationen, die im Banken-, Finanz- und Energiesektor tätig sind, aufgrund ihrer Rolle bei der Finanzierung der Kriegsanstrengungen Russlands und der Unterstützung seiner Schattenflotte verhängt.

items.title: Strike on Kerch Bridge marks another impressive success for Ukraine – Austrian colonel
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces have achieved an impressive result by causing an arch of the Kerch Bridge’s road section to collapse, despite the extensive protection system Russia had spent several years building around the structure.

items.title: UK defense secretary praises Ukraine's strike on Kerch Bridge, calls year terrible for Putin
items.teaser: The United Kingdom welcomes the Ukrainian Defense Forces' operation against the Kerch Strait Bridge.

items.title: Ukraine has proposed Oleshky-like humanitarian operation in 10 more occupied settlements, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that discussions would follow with the American mediators to organize a much-needed humanitarian operation.

items.title: USA: Vier Minister ziehen wegen Iran-Bedrohung aufs Militärgelände
items.teaser: Iranische Anschlagspläne, vier Trump-Minister in Sicherheitsunterkünften und rätselhafte Ausfälle bei Microsoft, Banken, Fluggesellschaften und sogar dem Geheimdienst NSA. In den USA häufen sich technische Störungen. Das Vertrauen in die Regierung schwindet.

items.title: Russian military transport plane crashes, 17 feared dead
items.teaser: A Russian An-12 military transport aircraft has crashed in the Kemerovo region, with 17 people reportedly on board, according to Russian media.

items.title: Terrorismus - Nordmazedonien vereitelt von Iraner gesteuertes Attentat in Griechenland
items.teaser: Der Geheimdienst Nordmazedoniens hat nach eigenen Angaben ein mit dem Iran verbundenes Netzwerk ausgehoben und ein "terroristisches" Attentat vereitelt.

items.title: Rebecca Barth, ARD Kiew, zum Angriff auf die Krim-Brücke
items.teaser: Rebecca Barth, ARD Kiew, zum Angriff auf die Krim-Brücke

items.title: 15 Ukrainians among 46 injured in Prague train collision
items.teaser: The trains were traveling at low speed when they collided, and most passengers only sustained minor to moderate injuries. Rail service resumed at the train station six hours later.

items.title: Bundeswehr tests Ukraine’s DELTA system, considers adopting it – Pistorius
items.teaser: The German Army tested Ukraine’s DELTA digital battlefield management and situational awareness system during a drone warfare exercise in October. Germany now plans to further develop the system jointly with Ukraine and assess its suitability for Bundeswehr use

items.title: Kyiv begins preparations for tunnel under Dnipro with help from US company Robbins
items.teaser: Ukraine's Minister for Restoration, Infrastructure and Transport Mykola Kalashnyk has held a working meeting with representatives of U.S. company Robbins to discuss the construction of a tunnel under the Dnipro River, including the technology and preparations for the project.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte treffen innerhalb eines Tages 10 Radare und EW-Bodenstationen auf der Krim und in Russland
items.teaser: Am 16. November und in der Nacht zum 17. November haben Einheiten der ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte 10 Werkzeuge zur Radaraufklärung und elektronischen Kriegsführung der russischen Armee auf russischem Staatsgebiet und auf der annektierten Krim getroffen, teilt der Generalstab auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ramstein: Zelensky proposes swapping partners’ Patriot and IRIS-T missile stockpiles for future deliveries
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has proposed that Ukraine receive interceptor missiles for Patriot and IRIS-T systems currently held in partner countries’ stockpiles in exchange for missiles already ordered by Ukraine but scheduled for production and delivery at a later date.

items.title: UK to announce new commitments to strengthen Ukraine's air defenses – defense secretary
items.teaser: The United Kingdom will announce new commitments to strengthen Ukraine's air defenses. Allies must turn their existing commitments into real military capabilities to help Ukraine get through a difficult winter and ensure long-term defense support.

items.title: Zelenskyy requests 40 more F-16 fighter jets at Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president has called on Western allies to provide additional combat aircraft, including Swedish Gripens, French Rafales, and Mirages, to strengthen Ukraine's air force.

items.title: Russians strike key energy facility in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: This is the second attack on a key energy facility in the region in November. DTEK says repairs will begin once the military and emergency services give permission.

items.title: Canada will raise US limits on Ukraine’s Starshield access with Trump, its defense minister says, citing shared NORAD defenses
items.teaser: Canada’s defense minister, David McGuinty, says the US limits on Ukraine’s Starshield satellites are a problem for the whole continent.

items.title: Germany’s largest bank was warned about Russian oligarchs for years—leaked files show it kept firms they part-owned past the 2022 sanctions
items.teaser: Profit kept beating risk managers' warnings, the investigation found.

items.title: Analysis: Why Ukraine's strike on the Crimean Bridge is such a big deal
items.teaser: A section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait after a Ukrainian overnight strike on Nov. 17, in the heaviest blow so far to the most visible symbol of Russia's illegal annexation of Ukrainian Crimea. President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 17 that the strike was

items.title: USA: Geheimdienste alarmiert – Iran soll Anschlag in Washington planen
items.teaser: Der Iran soll aktiv Pläne für ein Attentat auf US-Gebiet verfolgen. Hochrangige Mitglieder der Trump-Regierung sind bereits auf Militärbasen umgezogen.

items.title: Rutte on strike on Crimean Bridge: Ukraine must defend itself, including by targeting Russian logistics
items.teaser: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has said that strikes on Russian logistics hubs are an inevitable part of Ukraine's defense, adding that footage showing the aftermath of the attack on the Kerch Strait Bridge suggests the Ukrainian operation may have been successful.

items.title: The drone boat type that sank Russian patrol ship Izumrud now has two kills of Russian sea drones
items.teaser: The Sargan 3000 struck again at night, Ukraine's Navy says.

items.title: "Das ist doch verrückt": ICE-Agenten setzen ehemaligen Box-Weltmeister fest
items.teaser: Einst kämpft er in den Vereinigten Staaten als Profiboxer, jetzt wird der frühere Weltmeister Jorge Linares von der US-Einwanderungsbehörde ICE in Texas festgehalten. Auch der WBA-Präsident reagiert.

items.title: UK urges allies at Ramstein to commit to military support for Ukraine through 2027
items.teaser: International partners must provide Ukraine with military assistance not only to help it weather a difficult winter but also throughout 2027, enabling it to continue holding the front line and maintain a strong position in future negotiations.

items.title: Bahn-Strecke Berlin-Hannover: Ausfälle und Verspätungen
items.teaser: Die Zugstrecke zwischen Berlin und Hannover ist ohnehin wegen Bauarbeiten beeinträchtigt. Jetzt kommt noch eine Störung dazu: Laut Bahn wurden Kabel beschädigt - bei Mäharbeiten an der Strecke.

items.title: USA prüfen mögliche Anschlagspläne Irans auf Washington
items.teaser: Der US-Sender CNN berichtet über iranische Anschlagspläne, die die Zündung einer sogenannten schmutzigen Bombe in Washington beinhalten sollen. US-Präsident Trump versichert, die USA nähmen das "sehr ernst" - und droht Teheran.

items.title: Over 1,000 air defense missiles: UK announces GBP 240M military aid package for Ukraine
items.teaser: The United Kingdom is providing Ukraine with a GBP 240 million ($316 million) military aid package that will include more than 1,000 additional short-range air defense missiles and over a dozen air defense radars.

items.title: Russian milbloggers are furious about the Crimean Bridge attack
items.teaser: Part of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait early on Nov. 17, rattling Kremlin supporters and raising fresh questions about Russia's air defenses and the Kremlin's broader strategy for the war in Ukraine. Ukraine concluded a seven-phase operation with a targeted strike on the

items.title: UK pledges over 1,000 short-range missiles for Ukraine in 240 million-pound air defense package
items.teaser: The new support is part of a £500 million ($659.8 million) package announced by the U.K. government in its budget to address urgent gaps in Ukraine's air defenses this winter.

items.title: SBU veröffentlicht Video von Angriff auf Krim - Brücke
items.teaser: Der Sicherheitsdienst der Ukraine (SBU) hat ein Video vom Angriff auf die Krim-Brücke in der Nacht zum 17. November veröffentlicht.

items.title: Moldova closes airspace after Russian Shahed drone spotted over capital – video
items.teaser: Passenger planes heading to Moldova had to be diverted to Romania after an attack drone from the Russian Federation crossed the border during a strike on Odesa Oblast.

items.title: The danger lurking in Russia's frozen wars
items.teaser: About a month ago, between Oct. 12 and 16, the Russian-occupied region of Georgia, a self-proclaimed "independent" republic of Abkhazia, announced an "operational-tactical" military exercise. Among the stated objectives was to enhance interoperability between Abkhazia's separatist armed forces and the Russian military

items.title: 100-MPH limit is disrupting Ukraine’s drone war. NATO chief says efforts are underway to restore Starshield speed for Kyiv
items.teaser: A 161 km/h cap along the front is blocking Ukraine’s interceptors against Russia’s jet-powered Shahed drones.

items.title: 17 killed in crash of Russian An-12 military plane in Siberia
items.teaser: A crash occurred near the village of Yagunovo in Kemerovo Oblast, in southwestern Siberia.

items.title: Missiles and equipment: Sweden, UK to help arm Ukraine’s Gripen fighter jets
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara, Swedish Defense Minister Pål Jonson, and UK Defense Secretary John Healey signed a letter of intent in Brussels outlining further cooperation under the Gripen for Ukraine initiative.

items.title: Thüringens Ministerpräsident Voigt gedenkt der Opfer des Anschlags von Krakau
items.teaser: Thüringens Regierungschef Voigt (CDU) ist mit einer Delegation aus dem Freistaat in Polen unterwegs. Konkret in der Partnerregion Kleinpolen. In Krakau gedachte er am Dienstag der Opfer des Anschlags vom 7. November.

items.title: Hungary halts rail services with Ukraine for 2 days after Russian attack on Zakarpattia
items.teaser: No railway infrastructure was damaged in the attack and no railway workers were injured, Ukraine's state railway operator Ukrzaliznytsia said.

items.title: Festnahme in Brandenburg: Wie ein Ukrainer für Russland spioniert haben soll
items.teaser: Mitte Oktober ließ der Generalbundesanwalt in Eisenhüttenstadt einen Ukrainer festnehmen, der für einen russischen Geheimdienst spioniert haben soll. Recherchen von ARD-Hauptstadtstudio und SWR verdeutlichen den Umfang des mutmaßlichen Verrats.

items.title: Ukraine took little more than day to down Kerch Bridge Russia spent years fortifying, military analyst says
items.teaser: The loss of the Crimean Bridge has “a complex significance” for Russia, military analyst Oleksandr Kovalenko says.

items.title: EU- Botschafterin: das wahre Gesicht Russlands ist Raketenangriff auf die Ukraine und nicht „Friedensshow“ in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: Die EU-Botschafterin in der Ukraine, Katarina Maternova, verurteilte den massiven russischen Raketenangriff auf Kyjiw und andere ukrainische Städte in der Nacht auf den 17. November und wies auf den Kontrast zwischen den Angriffen Russlands und seinen Friedensbekundungen während der Verhandlungen in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Statement NATO-Generalsekretär Rutte vor Ukraine-Treffen
items.teaser: Doorstep von NATO-Generalsekretär Mark Rutte vor dem Treffen der Ukraine-Kontaktgruppe

items.title: Russia reports plane crash, likely involving An-12 military transport aircraft: 17 people killed
items.teaser: A military transport aircraft reportedly crashed near Yagunovo in Kemerovo Oblast. Russian authorities are investigating the circumstances of the incident.

items.title: Korolivskyi Smak plant in Kirovohrad region destroyed following Russian strike
items.teaser: Korolivskyi Smak, a Ukrainian producer of sunflower oil and other food products, has permanently halted production after a Russian strike triggered a large-scale fire that destroyed the facility.

items.title: Magdeburg: Schwimmbecken im früheren Gerichtssaal muss mehrfach befüllt werden
items.teaser: In Magdeburg wird im früheren Anschlags-Gerichtsgebäude das Schwimmbecken gefüllt. Zuvor haben Lecks Probleme verursacht. Im Dezember soll der Betrieb starten.

items.title: UK announces US$316m air defence package for Ukraine
items.teaser: The UK government has announced a new £240 million military aid package to strengthen Ukraine's air defence capabilities this winter, including short-range missiles and launchers.

items.title: Finland denies entry to Russian figure skaters for Grand Prix stage
items.teaser: Russian athletes will miss the upcoming ISU figure skating competition in Helsinki after the Finnish authorities refused to allow them to cross the border.

items.title: Zerstörte Krim-Brücke: Was heißt das für Russland?
items.teaser: Die wichtige Krim-Brücke ist nach ukrainischen Angriffen teilweise eingestürzt. Was heißt das für die Versorgung der russisch besetzten Gebiete? Oberst Markus Reisner ordnet ein.

items.title: Xi, Trump, Putin - drei Präsidenten, drei Agenden
items.teaser: Zwei der drei Großnationen führen aktuell einen Krieg. Ob sie jetzt mit China ein Konzept für den Weltfrieden finden? Es war bisher nie leicht, dass die USA und China im Handelskonflikt einen gemeinsamen Nenner fanden.

items.title: Ukraine, Finland sign memorandum on joint defense production
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen signed a memorandum on joint defense production during a meeting in Brussels.

items.title: UK anticipates "number of announcements" on weapons for Ukraine at Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting
items.teaser: A series of announcements on new military aid for Ukraine from its allies, including new UK air defence commitments, will be made at a meeting of the Ukraine Defence Contact Group (also known as the Ramstein format) in Brussels on 17 November.

items.title: NATO secretary general backs strikes on Crimean Bridge: "It is important that Ukraine defends itself"
items.teaser: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte says Ukraine has the right to defend itself, but notes that the exact circumstances of the strike on the Crimean Bridge have not been established yet.

items.title: Zahl der Verletzten nach russischem Angriff auf Saporischschja steigt auf 38, zwei Personen kamen ums Leben
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten nach einem russischen Angriff auf Saporischschja ist auf 38 angestiegen. Zwei Menschen wurden getötet, teilt der Co-Vorsitzende des Verteidigungsrats der Region Saporischschja, Iwan Fedorow, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Würde Kyjiw den Donbass für einen NATO-Beitritt aufgeben?
items.teaser: Die USA wollen wissen, ob die Ukraine im Gegenzug für einen NATO-Beitritt den von Russland nicht besetzten Teil des Gebiets Donezk räumen würde. Von der DW befragte Experten erläutern, warum diese Idee gefährlich ist.

items.title: Traffic partially resumed on Kyiv's Pivdennyi Bridge
items.teaser: Vehicles weighing up to 10 tonnes and public transport up to 18 tonnes can use the bridge towards the right bank. Traffic in the opposite direction remains closed.

items.title: Ukraine harvests 68.2 Mt of grain and oilseed crops
items.teaser: As of November 17, Ukrainian farmers had harvested 50.1 million tonnes of grain crops, including 26.26 million tonnes of wheat, as well as 18.1 million tonnes of oilseed crops.

items.title: Monument to North Korean soldiers who fought against Ukraine appears in Kursk
items.teaser: Local authorities in the Russian city of Kursk have installed a sculpture to commemorate DPRK military personnel who fought in the war against Ukraine, though it is currently under a protective film.

items.title: Amount of FIFA and UEFA payments to Russia since full-scale invasion revealed
items.teaser: An investigation by British media indicates that global football governing bodies have allocated over £45 million to the aggressor state's football association since early 2022.

items.title: Zelensky announces Berlin talks with US, European allies to shape next phase of Russia negotiations
items.teaser: The Berlin meeting could take place on Nov. 19, a Ukrainian official told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: APEC summit: What Trump, Xi and Putin want
items.teaser: Trump, Xi and Putin will hold their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC. With different priorities on trade, Ukraine, Iran and arms control, what does each leader hope to gain?

items.title: Generalstab bestätigt Treffer auf Gazprom-Anlage in Baschkortostan
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den 17. November haben die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte eine große Gazprom-Raffinerie in der russischen Republik Baschkortostan getroffen – etwa 1500 Kilometer von der ukrainischen Grenze entfernt, teilt der Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Zelenskyy outlines preparation for major prisoner swap: intelligence agencies in contact
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president has stated that Kyiv will hand over its proposals for an exchange of prisoners of war to Washington following recent agreements reached in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Once shunned, Poland's Ukraine-bashing firebrand sees political breakthrough
items.teaser: Once too extreme even for Polish conservatives, far-right firebrand Grzegorz Braun is now being courted by leading right-wing politicians as they seek to unite ahead of the 2027 elections. Braun, a Moscow-friendly provocateur facing multiple charges for his antisemitic, anti-LGBT, and anti-Ukrainian stunts, leads the C

items.title: EU to assist Ukraine in developing customs IT systems
items.teaser: The European Union will provide Ukraine with expert, financial and technical support through October 2029 to develop the customs IT systems required for the country's accession to the EU.

items.title: Grain carrier Betul 8 capsizes off Bulgaria with wheat for Egypt, likely hit by Russian sea drones, ISW says
items.teaser: A Bulgarian maritime outlet says the drones looked like the type that sank a container ship off the same coast last month.

items.title: Ukraine greift erneut Krim-Brücke an
items.teaser: Ukraine greift erneut Krim-Brücke an

items.title: Axios: Witkoff, Kushner to meet Ukrainian, EU officials to discuss peace plan
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump's special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are planning to meet with Ukrainian and European officials this week to discuss security guarantees and a plan for Ukraine's postwar economic recovery.

items.title: Teheran "ist nun mal verrückt": Trump nimmt Bedrohung durch schmutzige Bombe "sehr ernst"
items.teaser: US-Geheimdienste befürchten einem Medienbericht zufolge, dass radioaktives Material in die Vereinigten Staaten gelangt sein könnte. Im Raum steht ein möglicher Anschlagsplan in Washington. Präsident Trump spricht von einer sehr ernsten Bedrohung und richtet eine scharfe Warnung an Teheran.

items.title: Missile-drones, cruise missiles, and a Flamingo guided to the last second: Kyiv’s account of the night Russia’s Kerch bridge lost its road
items.teaser: The guidance link held to the last seconds, Zelenskyy says, while the SBU says its Palianytsia missile-drones sent the road span into the water.

items.title: BTA Bank to rebrand as NovaBank
items.teaser: NOVA Group has completed its acquisition of JSC BTA Bank and is moving ahead with its integration with NovaPay, paving the way for operations under the NovaBank brand.

items.title: Train collision in Czechia: 15 Ukrainian citizens among those injured
items.teaser: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry says 15 Ukrainian citizens were among 46 people who suffered minor injuries when two trains collided near Prague's main railway station.

items.title: New EU funding rules to protect sports from Russian influence, visa ban in the works
items.teaser: "With EU taxpayers' money ... we will not, of course, support and finance participants that are connected to the types of symbolism of violence and aggression," EU Commissioner Roxana Minzatu said.

items.title: Anschlag in London: „Zünde ihn an“, sagte er auf FaceTime
items.teaser: Der Iran setzt im Konflikt mit den USA und Israel offenbar auf eine neue Strategie: Über kriminelle Netzwerke organisiert Teheran Anschläge auf Synagogen und US-Einrichtungen in Europa.

items.title: Luftwaffe wehrt drei russische gelenkte Fliegerbomben, drei Banderol - Marschflugkörper und 205 Drohnen ab
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge drei gelenkte Fliegerbomben vom Typ Ch-59/Ch-69, drei Banderol/ Dan-Т- Marschflugkörper und 205 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine seit Abend des 16. November angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: Russia says it will rebuild Crimean Bridge 'even better.' Here's why they'll be disappointed
items.teaser: Russia has vowed to restore the Crimean Bridge after Ukrainian drones and missiles struck the structure on Nov. 17, collapsing a major section of its roadway, but experts told the Kyiv Independent that repairs could take a year or more and require significant resources. The bridge is a key logistics

items.title: Dutch company withdraws lawsuit against Ukraine’s honorary consul in Netherlands over alleged ties to Russia
items.teaser: Dutch company Peja Group has withdrawn an urgent court application against Karel Burger Dirven, Honorary Consul of Ukraine in the Netherlands, whom it accused of allegedly making defamatory statements about its business ties with Russia.

items.title: Deutschland kauft neue Flugabwehrraketen für Ukraine
items.teaser: Der Ukraine droht angesichts massiver russischer Angriffe ein harter Winter. Die Bundesregierung will Kiew helfen - vor allem bei der Flugabwehr. Sie kauft dafür Waffen aus den USA.

items.title: Ukrainian vegetable oil company reports massive destruction and colossal losses following attack
items.teaser: The Viktor & K company, which produces food under the Korolivskyi Smak brand, has been forced to completely suspend production after a Russian strike caused extensive damage and one fatality.

items.title: Russland plant Aneignung von über tausend Häusern in besetzten Teilen der Region Cherson – Geheimdienst
items.teaser: Russland bereitet die sogenannte „Nationalisierung“ von über 1.100 Wohnhäusern ukrainischer Staatsbürger in den vorübergehend besetzten Teilen der Region Cherson vor.

items.title: Ukraine’s air defense neutralizes three Russian missiles, three Banderols, 205 drones
items.teaser: As of 12:00 on Tuesday, November 17, Ukraine's air defense forces had neutralized three Kh-59/Kh-69 guided aerial missiles, three S8000 Banderol/Dan-T missiles and 205 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 16.

items.title: Anti-Corruption Bureau director says second Operation Carthage brought too many enemies
items.teaser: The heads of Ukraine's anti-corruption bodies have warned of various information operations aimed at undermining public trust in the Specialised Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) and the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) in connection with the investigations into the Carthage case.

items.title: Verteidigungsministerium: Angriff auf Kertsch-Brücke ausschließlich mit ukrainischen Waffen durchgeführt
items.teaser: Das Verteidigungsministerium der Ukraine betonte auf Facebook, dass bei der mehrstufigen Operation zur Zerstörung der Kertsch-Brücke ausschließlich ukrainische Waffen zum Einsatz kamen.

items.title: General Staff confirms strike on Gazprom oil refinery in Bashkortostan
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat facility in Russia's Bashkortostan overnight on November 17, approximately 1,500 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.

items.title: Rescuers spent 14 days searching the ruins of a Ukrainian aid hub where Russia killed 72 people, and four more are still missing
items.teaser: Russia kept striking the site while crews dug, and DNA tests confirmed some of the deaths.

items.title: Trump wants one-on-one meeting with Putin
items.teaser: The US president has revealed his willingness to hold direct bilateral talks with the Russian leader in Shenzhen, alongside their scheduled trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping.

items.title: Selenskyj: „Paljanyzja“ traf Autoteil der Kertsch-Brücke, „Neptun“, „Ruta“ und FP-5 Eisenbahnstrecke
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj gab heute auf Facebook Details zur Operation gegen die Kertsch-Brücke bekannt. Laut seinen Angaben umfasste sie sieben Etappen, die über mehrere Wochen durchgeführt wurden.

items.title: Russian drone strikes police vehicle in Sumy region, two officers injured
items.teaser: Two police officers were injured when a Russian drone struck a police vehicle in the town of Hlukhiv, Shostka district, Sumy region.

items.title: Hungary suspends rail services to Ukraine due to Russian attacks
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has announced the Hungarian government's decision to suspend rail services to Ukraine on Tuesday 17 November and Wednesday 18 November due to Russian attacks on Zakarpattia Oblast.

items.title: Selenskyj bestätigt teilweise Zerstörung der Krim-Brücke
items.teaser: Das ukrainische Militär hat offenbar einen Teil der Krim-Brücke zerstört. Fotos und Videos zeigen, dass einer der beiden Brückenbögen eingestürzt ist. Die Verbindung auf die Krim war stets ein Prestigeprojekt Putins.

items.title: Air defence downs 3 missiles and over 200 Russian drones: Impacts recorded at 44 locations
items.teaser: Starting on the evening of 16 November, Russia launched over 300 UAVs alongside ballistic and cruise missiles against Ukraine, with air defences downing 205 drones and three missiles while impacts struck 44 sites.

items.title: 7th Air Assault Corps Commander Lasiichuk: If Pokrovsk had simply let the Russians through, Dobropillia would no longer exist
USF commander shows drones used in strike on Crimean Bridge
items.teaser: Robert Brovdi, commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, has shown the drones used in the strike on the Kerch Strait Bridge.

items.title: Einer der größten russischen Petrochemiekomplexe in Baschkortostan nach Angriff in Flammen
items.teaser: In Baschkortostan, Russland, wurde einer der größten russischen Petrochemiekomplexe, Gazprom Neftechim Salavat, angegriffen.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Russia-Crimea bridge appears destroyed after strike
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said a strike on the Kerch bridge in Crimea was in response to continued Russian attacks targeting his country's infrastructure. Meanwhile, two bridges were hit in Russian attacks on Kyiv. DW has more.

items.title: Arch and road span collapse: General Staff confirms results of strike on Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: The arch and a span of the road section of the Kerch Strait Bridge collapsed following a strike by Ukraine's Defense Forces overnight on November 17.

items.title: Zwei Tote, ein Verletzter bei russischem Angriff auf Kyjiw
items.teaser: Beim russischen Raketen- und Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw am 17. November wurden zwei Menschen getötet und ein weiterer verletzt.

items.title: Moskau beruft Krisensitzung nach Angriff auf Krim-Brücke ein
items.teaser: Die Folgen der ukrainischen Attacke müssten bewältigt werden, heißt es kurz vor der von Vize-Regierungschef Marat Chusnullin geleiteten Sondersitzung. In Agenturberichten ist von schweren Schäden an der Brücke die Rede.

items.title: Families with children ordered to evacuate from Balabyne in Zaporizhzhia region
items.teaser: Families with children have been ordered to evacuate from the settlement of Balabyne, near Zaporizhzhia, under an order issued by the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration.

items.title: Russian forces strike Mukachevo in Zakarpattia region
items.teaser: The Russian military attacked the city of Mukachevo in Ukraine’s western Zakarpattia region on November 17.

items.title: Verstoß gegen Kriegswaffengesetz: Polizei durchsucht Haus von Ibrahim Ibrahims Sohn
items.teaser: Die Berliner Staatsanwaltschaft bestätigt eine Hausdurchsuchung bei dem Sohn des Anti-Israel-Aktivisten und Terror-Unterstützers Ibrahim Ibrahim.

items.title: Einer der Bögen der Krim-Brücke beim erneuten Angriff beschädigt
items.teaser: Einer der beiden Brückenbögen der Krim-Brücke wurde bei einem Angriff beschädigt.

items.title: Germany to contribute $300M to new PURL package with Patriot missiles – Pistorius
items.teaser: Germany will contribute $300 million to a new package of U.S. weapons purchases for Ukraine under the PURL initiative, jointly funded with Norway. The package will focus primarily on strengthening Ukraine’s air defenses by providing missiles for Patriot systems.

items.title: Palianytsia struck road section of Crimean Bridge, Neptune, Ruta, and FP-5 hit rail section - Zelensky
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has revealed details of the operation targeting the Crimean Bridge, saying it consisted of seven stages carried out over several weeks.

items.title: Russia opposes separate Black Sea deal without a peace agreement, Turkish FM says
